name: M.O.F
source: After the death of his parents, the protagonist lives with classmate Kukuri Shiroyama and her father. He maintains a normal school life, but bloody nightmares of his past begin to haunt him. Tension only builds when members of the school start to go missing...
translation: 父母去世后，主角与同班同学Kukuri Shiroyama及她的父亲一起生活。他原本过着平常的校园生活，然而，与过去有关的血腥噩梦开始纠缠着他。当学校里接连有人失踪时，不安也愈发强烈…
